description: Remove a company from the Agent Company Index on behalf of that company. Give the company's domain and a work email address on exactly that domain (ask the user for it). ACI emails a private confirmation link to that address; once someone there opens it and presses Remove, every published profile of the domain goes offline within a few minutes and the company gets an email. Nothing changes without that confirmation. Profiles under an agreement with ACI's owner are checked by a person first.

domain.description: The company's own domain, e.g. example.com

work_email.description: An address on exactly that domain; the confirmation link goes there.

name: request_listing_removal
title: Request listing removal
